command:
set -euo pipefail
cd projects/kobra2-neo
JOB=/tmp/kobra-stephansdom-ready-20260929-50/job
G="$JOB/output.gcode"
R="$JOB/report.json"
PORT=/dev/cu.usbserial-120
test -f "$G"
test -f "$R"
SHA=$(shasum -a 256 "$G" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$SHA" = "41d314b85bfd19490af07709797681711514947748e4d00dbe5c9b440f482887"
.venv/bin/python - "$R" "$PORT" <<'PY'
import json, sys
from kobra_live import PosixSerial, _identify
r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert r['source']['sha256'] == 'b8f500646869f0ce2e6e32b0448b55e13e76198c69ea0a275d8b41d9df48321e'
assert r['artifacts']['gcode_sha256'] == '41d314b85bfd19490af07709797681711514947748e4d00dbe5c9b440f482887'
assert r['safety']['valid'] is True
p=r['profile']
assert p['pen_up_z'] == 4.97 and p['pen_down_z'] == 2.97
assert p['motion']['travel_feed'] == 6000.0
assert p['motion']['draw_feed'] == 2400.0
assert p['motion']['z_feed'] == 360.0
with PosixSerial(sys.argv[2]) as serial:
    _identify(serial)
print('PRINTER_IDENTIFIED_PRECHECK', sys.argv[2], flush=True)
PY
echo RESULT:PORT_IDENTIFIED port=$PORT
.venv/bin/kobra-live "$G" --report "$R" --profile config/kobra2_neo_pen.toml --port "$PORT" --expect-sha256 "$SHA" --progress-every 100 --thermal-check-every 250
